_comment: The eco-design audit in CI (docs/conventions/eco-design.md). eco-design.yml fetches green-claude
from `repository` at `commit` and runs its audit on every pull request. It is third-party code:
`commit` is one someone read in full (audit script, detectors, inspectors), never a branch, and
`read` the date of that reading. A bump is a new reading (§ Bumping the pin).
`fail_on`: none (report only), or high, medium, low — a new finding of that impact or above fails the check.
